question: If BOOK is coded as 43, then PEN is coded as:
explanation:
• Sum of position numbers: B=2,O=15,O=15,K=11 → 43. P=16,E=5,N=14 → 35.
• Letter position (A=1, B=2, ...).

question: Ratio of 2:3 is same as:
explanation:
• 2:3 = 4:6 (multiply both by 2). Equivalent ratios.
• 3:2 is inverse.

question: A is the mother of B. C is the son of A. What is B to C?
explanation:
• A = mother of B and of C (C is son of A). So B and C are siblings.
• B can be brother or sister of C.

question: If 5 workers complete a work in 10 days, how many days for 10 workers?
explanation:
• More workers → fewer days. Man-days = 5×10 = 50. 10 workers → 50/10 = 5 days.
• Inverse proportion.

question: Find odd one: 3, 5, 7, 9, 11
explanation:
• 3,5,7,11 are prime. 9 is not prime (3×3).
• So 9 is the odd one out.

question: Speed = 60 km/h, Time = 2 hours. Distance = ?
explanation:
• Distance = Speed × Time = 60 × 2 = 120 km.
• Formula: D = S × T.

question: If CAT is coded as 24, DOG is:
explanation:
• Sum: C=3, A=1, T=20 → 24. D=4, O=15, G=7 → 26.
• Alphabet position A=1 to Z=26.

question: A man faces North. He turns 90° clockwise. He now faces:
explanation:
• Facing North; 90° clockwise → East.
• 180° → South; 270° clockwise (or 90° anti) → West.

question: Profit = Selling Price - ?
explanation:
• Profit = SP - CP. Loss = CP - SP.
• Profit % = (Profit/CP)×100.

question: Simple Interest = (P × R × T)/100. P is:
explanation:
• SI = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100. P = principal (sum), R = rate % p.a., T = time in years.
• CI is compound interest.

question: Next in series: 5, 10, 20, 40, ?
explanation:
• Pattern: multiply by 2. 5→10→20→40→80.
• Geometric progression.

question: If A is brother of B and B is sister of C, and C is mother of D, then A is D's:
explanation:
• A = brother of B; B = sister of C; C = mother of D. So C is parent of D; A is sibling of B and C. A is uncle of D.
• Blood relation.

question: CODED is written as DPEFE. How is MARCH written?
explanation:
• Each letter +1: C→D, O→P, D→E, E→F, D→E. So M→N, A→B, R→S, C→D, H→I → NBSDI.
• Coding-decoding.

question: 12 men complete a work in 9 days. How many men to complete in 6 days?
explanation:
• Man-days = 12×9 = 108. For 6 days: 108/6 = 18 men.
• Inverse proportion.

question: Find odd: 2, 4, 6, 8, 9
explanation:
• 2,4,6,8 are even. 9 is odd number.
• Odd one out.

question: Distance 240 km, Speed 48 km/h. Time = ? hours
explanation:
• Time = Distance/Speed = 240/48 = 5 hours.
• T = D/S.

question: Ratio 4:5. If antecedent is 20, consequent is:
explanation:
• 4:5 = 20:x → 4/5 = 20/x → x = 20×5/4 = 25.
• Antecedent:consequent.

question: Sum of first 5 natural numbers:
explanation:
• 1+2+3+4+5 = 15. Formula n(n+1)/2 = 5×6/2 = 15.
• Natural numbers.

question: If MORNING is coded as LPQMFMH, pattern is:
options: B. -1 each letter (M→L, O→P? No - O→N, N→M)
explanation:
• Each letter -1: M→L, O→N, R→Q, N→M, I→H, N→M, G→F. So LPQMFMH (N→M, I→H).
• Alphabet position shift.

question: A is taller than B. C is shorter than B. Who is shortest?
explanation:
• A > B > C (height). So C is shortest.
• Ordering.

question: Venn diagram: Some A are B. Some B are C. Conclusion:
options: C. Some A may be C (not definite)
explanation:
• Some A are B, some B are C. We cannot conclude all A are C or no A is C. Some A may be C.
• Syllogism.

question: How many 3s in the number 33333?
explanation:
• 33333 has five digits, all 3. So five 3s.
• Counting.

question: Loss % = (Loss/CP)×?
explanation:
• Loss % = (Loss / Cost Price) × 100.
• Same as profit % formula.
